study.title: Detection and Counting of Maize Leaves Based on Two-Stage Deep Learning with UAV-Based RGB Image
study.short_title: Two-Stage Mask R-CNN + YOLOv5 for Maize Leaf Counting

segmentation.best_model: Mask R-CNN ResNet50 + SmoothLR (Bbox AP 0.969, Mask AP 0.952) followed by YOLOv5x

dataset.name: UAV RGB images of maize seedlings, Farmland Irrigation Research Institute, Xinxiang, Henan, China
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 Pro V2.0 (20 MP 1-inch CMOS, 5472x3648) at 5 m altitude; 1005 cropped 640x640 images split 7:2:1 (train/val/test); instance segmentation of maize seedlings (2646/692/101 after augmentation; detection stage 2963/847/101); leaf classes: fully unfolded leaf, newly appeared leaf; 492 maize inbred varieties.

mIoU.ambiguity: Instance segmentation evaluated with mask mAP (0.952 at IoU 0.5); no semantic mIoU reported.

F1.ambiguity: Leaf detection reported via precision/recall/AP instead (e.g., fully-unfolded-leaf AP 0.896, recall 0.844; new leaf AP 0.540, recall 0.500).

PA.ambiguity: Primary segmentation metric is mask mAP 95.2% at IoU=0.5 (ResNet50 SmoothLR); no overall pixel accuracy reported.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weeds removed by background segmentation rather than classified.

edge.device: None - offline (NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000 48 GB, Intel Xeon Gold 6246R, 128 GB RAM, Windows 10)
edge.framework: PyTorch 1.7.1, Python 3.7, OpenCV 4.5.1 (Mask R-CNN via MMDetection w/ ImageNet-pretrained weights; YOLOv5 v6.0 w/ COCO-pretrained weights, SGD)

fps.ambiguity: Inference times 0.05 s (detection) / 0.07 s (segmentation) per image on a desktop GPU; not an edge deployment.

latency_ms.quote: The inference times for image detection boxes and masks were 0.05s and 0.07s, respectively.
latency_ms.ambiguity: Segmentation inference time ~0.07 s per 640x640 image on desktop NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000 (Xeon Gold 6246R); NOT on-board/edge hardware.

issues: Instance-segmentation/object-detection study (mask AP, bbox AP) - no semantic segmentation RQ1 metrics (mIoU/F1/Dice/PA) extractable.
Inference timing on desktop GPU, not edge hardware.
